title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP09 — prepare analysis evidence destinations
goal: Temporarily exclude empty reviewed analysis destination directories so a later protected move can register their exact JSON paths without trusting head-defined policy.
acceptanceCriteria: The two future analysis evidence/report directories are temporarily excluded while they remain empty; no evidence file is moved or created.
The policy registry remains schema-valid and its trusted-base and weaken-policy obligations are authorized and consumed in separate commits.

The subsequent CP09 candidate can add and register the exact JSON paths while removing the exclusions, and can be evaluated entirely by the prepared base registry without any head-defined registration exception.
